dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual reduction in the transverse width of the dorsal plane from the pectoral region towards the posterior terminus of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized lateral extensions corresponding to the pectoral fins; otherwise smooth margins with minor variance due to surface water spray.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with uniform pixel distribution across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Negligible spatial frequency of dark-pixel clusters; surface presents a homogenous depigmented phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp transition with high pixel intensity gradient at the epidermal-water boundary.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Three distinct low-intensity focal points: one at the blowhole vertex and two vertically aligned marks on the left mid-lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three distinct punctate dark markers visible: one cephalic at the blowhole and a pair on the mid-body left lateral edge.
